description: Represents a SMN notification topic resource.

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: Topic display name, which is presented as the name of the email sender in an email message. The topic display name contains a maximum of 192 bytes.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the topic to be created. The topic name is a string of 1 to 256 characters. It must contain upper- or lower-case letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and must start with a letter or digit.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region to which the project belongs.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.

examples:
- name: Create a smn topic
  community.general.hwc_smn_topic:
    identity_endpoint: "{{ identity_endpoint }}"
    user_name: "{{ user_name }}"
    password: "{{ password }}"
    domain_name: "{{ domain_name }}"
    project_name: "{{ project_name }}"
    region: "{{ region }}"
    name: "ansible_smn_topic_test"
    state: present

return_values.name: create_time
return_values.description: Time when the topic was created. Returned: success

return_values.name: display_name
return_values.description: Topic display name, which is presented as the name of the email sender in an email message. The topic display name contains a maximum of 192 bytes. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the topic to be created. The topic name is a string of 1 to 256 characters. It must contain upper- or lower-case letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and must start with a letter or digit. Returned: success

return_values.name: push_policy
return_values.description: Message pushing policy. 0 indicates that the message sending fails and the message is cached in the queue. 1 indicates that the failed message is discarded. Returned: success

return_values.name: topic_urn
return_values.description: Resource identifier of a topic, which is unique. Returned: success

return_values.name: update_time
return_values.description: Time when the topic was updated. Returned: success
